name: noise-gone
desc: Free, open-source audio noise remover for Windows — local AI denoise for voice recordings, batch cleanup. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Local AI denoise** — fan hum, room tone and keyboard clatter removed with ONNX models on your machine
✅ **Noise profile learn** — select two seconds of pure noise and the filter targets that exact signature
✅ **Strength dial** — from subtle cleanup to aggressive extraction, with an A/B bypass button
✅ **Batch podcast cleanup** — a folder of episodes processed with identical settings
✅ **Voice and music modes** — speech-optimized or gentle mode that leaves room reverb natural
✅ **Waveform A and B** — original and cleaned waveforms stacked for instant comparison
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **noise-gone** | Adobe Podcast Enhance | Krisp | Audacity noise reduction |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free web, limits | Paid subscription | Free, OSS |
| Files stay local | **Yes** | Upload | Yes | Yes
| Batch episodes | **Yes** | One at a time | Calls only | Manual
| Noise profile learning | **Yes** | No | Auto only | Manual FFT
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Browser | Installer | Installer
faqQ: how to remove background noise from recordings free, offline?
faqA: Cloud enhancers upload every recording and cap free runs, and classic spectral tools need an audio engineer's patience. noise-gone learns your noise profile, denoises with local models and batches whole folders. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, unlimited, with a bypass button so you can trust what it changed.
s1: Dark audio view (#121417, cyan #06B6D4): stacked waveforms before and after, noise profile strip at the head, strength dial at 0.7, A-B bypass lit.
s2: Batch panel: 38 episode files queued with minutes-saved column, voice mode badge, progress at 61 percent, folder destination chip.
s3: Profile step: two-second selection highlighted on the waveform, learn button, noise signature mini-chart, apply-to-all checkbox enabled.
